## Ruling recorded at dispatch (PM seat `domain:devx @ objectstack`, #6023) — **option 1: print the measurement only on failure**

The threshold (`< 10000`) is the contract; a passing run's exact timing is not evidence anyone reads, and a varying number inside a `✓` line defeats the byte-identical comparison every b5/Tier B review relies on — an allowance that, once habitual, lets a real delta through. Option 2 (keep it outside the `✓` line) still leaves a varying line in the stream; option 3 (document the normalisation) institutionalises the allowance. So: the green line becomes `✓ C2 a healthy tree is not slowed (< 10000 ms)` (or the file's own stable wording), and the measured figure is printed in the FAILURE message only, where it is diagnostic. Assertion condition unchanged. Size S, one file (`scripts/pm/release-rehearsal-clone.mjs`, floored by #15399 at 30 — the floor is untouched). Dispatched now.
